ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white) coverage concentrated in the medial-to-distal regions of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, irregular high-intensity contiguous blobs located in the central regions of the lobes. The left lobe contains an elongated white region extending from the lower center toward the upper tip. The right lobe contains a similar white region with higher internal mottling. Fine white speckling is scattered across the remaining low-intensity surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel angle of 85 degrees and a vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks of approximately 15%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge margin. The distal tips exhibit high-amplitude irregular protrusions (peaks) isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the trailing edge transitioning into an upward-swept concave curve near the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast circular pixel groups (white-on-black) visible near the median notch and on the leading edge of the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, short linear pixel disruptions (~10-30 pixels) visible as light marks against the dark pigmentation on the left lobe and as dark disruptions within the white patch of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips causing significant geometric irregularity. Multiple small 'U-shaped' indentations (nicks) visible along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct circular dark pigmentation 'island' or ring-like feature located within the upper portion of the high-intensity white patch on the left lobe.
